subject: Cross-team rollout, new API keys, and renewal terms for Brite Financial
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brite.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brite.com>, procure@brite.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expansion questions

Hi Sean,

We're excited to move forward with the renewal but have a few wrinkles on the expansion side. We plan to roll Redwood out to three more product teams (Payments, Fraud Ops, and Merchant Success) starting in Q3. That means: new API keys per team, expected concurrency increase, and a desire to adjust the committed token quantity upward.

Can you (or someone on your team) confirm: 1) whether we can get team-scoped API keys that map to separate billing lines, 2) an updated pricing estimate for +3 teams with a 2x throughput cushion, and 3) a suggested rollout schedule so we can coordinate procurement and security reviews?

Alex
Senior PM, Integrations
Brite Financial

---
Note: attaching our internal onboarding checklist (see procurement).
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brite.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expansion questions

Alex — thanks for the overview and congrats on the decision to expand. Quick answers up front: yes, we support team-scoped API keys and can map usage to separate billing lines; we can size committed capacity with a cushion for burst; and we can propose a phased rollout that minimizes risk to production.

I'll have Dev and Marissa put together a proposed rollout plan and sizing/pricing this week. Laura, I'll need you on the pricing and renewal term change (annual vs. 18-month commit) options.

Proposed next step: 30-min call Thu 3/12 to run the plan by Alex and Sam and confirm procurement timing. Does that work?

—Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brite.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expansion questions

Alex, Sean — sharing a technical outline for the rollout so procurement/security can review. High level: 

- API Keys: we will provision one key per team scoped to their project with tag-based usage labels. Each key can be routed to a dedicated or shared model pool depending on performance needs.
- Capacity: recommend increasing committed tokens by 2.1x based on your current peak distribution; include a 20% burst budget for initial ramp.
- Environment separation: dev/staging/prod workspaces per team; optional dedicated capacity for Payments if latency SLA must be 50ms p95.
- Rollout schedule (suggested): Week 1 = key issuance + security review; Week 2 = dev/staging integration; Week 3 = canary in production (Payment team limited to 5% traffic); Week 4 = full production rollout for each team (staggered).

I'll attach a short diagram and a template for the onboarding checklist. Let me know if Brite's security team needs an architecture call.

—Dev
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: onboarding_diagram.png (image)
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brite.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brite.com>, procure@brite.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expansion questions

Thanks — Thu 3/12 at 11am PT works for us. A couple of clarifying items for the call:

1) Procurement asks if we can have the option to split the renewal into two invoices (existing product + expansion) and have separate PO numbers.
2) Security wants to ensure audit logs and data residency controls for the additional teams; can Marissa confirm the out-of-the-box retention and log export cadence?

We'll also bring our legal lead if we get into term language.

—Sam
Director, Product Ops | Brite Financial
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brite.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brite.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expansion questions

Sam — quick answers for your security/procurement items before the call: 

- Invoices / PO: We can invoice separately for existing commitment and the expansion (two line items). We can also accept separate PO numbers per invoice.
- Audit logs: We retain request/response logs for 90 days by default in hosted plans; we can extend retention to 1 year as an add-on and provide daily export to S3 (or a secure SFTP).
- Data residency: Redwood can pin model serving to a region; for US-based accounts we'll ensure worker placement in US regions only.

I'll be on the call to walk through the export options and will share a short doc summarizing retention SLAs.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: retention_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brite.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@brite.com>, procure@brite.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expansion questions

Appreciate the productive call last week — summarizing next steps and timelines so we have a single record: 

1) Pricing/commit: Laura to send two renewal options by Wed 3/24 — (A) 12-month renewal with expansion add-on (committed tokens + 2.1x) and (B) 18-month discounted commit that includes the expansion.
2) Procurement: Brite will submit two PO numbers (one for existing renewal, one for expansion) — procure@brite.com to confirm by 3/26.
3) Keys & onboard: Dev to provision team-scoped keys and send the onboarding bundle by Mon 3/29. Keys will be tagged and routed to dev/staging/prod workspaces as discussed.
4) Security: Marissa to deliver retention/export doc and, if needed, schedule an architecture review with security by 3/31.

Attachments I will send: draft SOW (SOW_Brite_Q3.pdf) and the pricing workbook (Redwood_pricing_v3.xlsx). Please confirm acceptance of the timeline; if anything needs to move earlier let me know.

Thanks — looking forward to expanding with you all.

—Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
